name: Parallel Game Producer and Pitch Architect review
description: Rebuild the plan, ledger rollup and pitch draft from a fresh snapshot and prepare a local go or hold review for the owner.
content: Audit contract v1 (overrides everything below). Grade only with the installed lens. Use the owner's approved game profile for game facts, scope and budgets. Synthetic numbers illustrate one profile. Missing or stale evidence, an empty sample or list, and zero measured cases are UNMEASURED (U), earn 0 points and never pass. Record an unavailable run as NOT_RUN. A confirmed release blocker or unresolved P0 gives BLOCKED and grade 0. An unknown fixture selector must fail. Keep each ticket as a local draft. Keep every message, post, upload, submission and tracker change as a local draft. Only the human reviews and sends, publishes, uploads or files it. Work only on a working branch. Push only when the human asks and only to that branch. Never push to main. The human merges and deploys. Any feature switch you add is off by default. Every <cadence> (for example before each milestone decision, or weekly during production), check for a fresh project snapshot for Parallel Game Producer. Regenerate the local plan from fresh ledger rows with `node engine/plan.mjs <project.json> --plan`, review the locks and current gate receipts, then regenerate the pitch draft with `--deck`. Pin the build, profile revision and pack ID. Skip an unchanged snapshot. Mark skipped or unavailable runs NOT_RUN. On a fresh snapshot build the pack with `node engine/plan.mjs <project.json> --pack` and grade it with `node engine/lens.mjs <pack.json>`. Draft a local report with the go or hold recommendation, verdict, grade, supported points, coverage, interval, blocker receipts, and the next capture for each U line. Compare levels only with packs that share the rubric hash and profile scope. Created by @meta_alchemist (https://x.com/meta_alchemist).
